fields.line1run1: I’ve noticed some articles in Over the Edge seem like they
fields.line2run1: could be AI-generated. Can you clarify your stance on AI
fields.line3run1: usage and explain how you ensure the content is original

fields.line1run1: Yes, we use AI tools at Over the Edge, but our student journalists drive every
fields.line2run1: story. AI helps with grammar, transitions, and flow, but the ideas and content are
fields.line3run1: entirely student-created. We’re still learning how to best use these tools and value
fields.line4run1: reader feedback as we refine our process. Student journalism remains at the core
